verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical crams of the 300x250. The product can is dropped, the legal fine print sits right under the headline and ahead of the body copy, and the body copy is almost as big as the headline. The CTA is wedged between badges, and the broken placeholder image collides with the Small Batch badge at the right edge. Everything is jammed edge to edge with no breathing room. In A, the Solstice logo is barely visible and gets lost behind the headline and ribbon. B shows the logo slightly more clearly at the top, which makes B marginally better on brand.
